title: Remapping Browser Search Key (MS Natural Keyboard 4000) to Ctrl + F opens "Project" Panel
author: TheSimArchitect

status.label: Waiting for current hardware-key repro
status.detail: The author reported that Browser Search remapping later worked, but also said the keyboard's original action can fire alongside the remap. A July 2026 request for a current-build repro is unanswered.

next_action: Await current-build confirmation and exact source key/output before selecting a fix path.

judgment.rationale: The author said the Browser Search key became mappable and the original Ctrl+F use then worked, but also described remapped keys triggering both the PowerToys output and the keyboard's original action. A maintainer reproduced both behaviors with a different browser key on another keyboard. The latest request for a current-build retest and numbered steps is unanswered, so the precise hardware/driver path remains unknown.
evidence: The original report uses PowerToys 0.78.0 and an MS Natural Ergonomic Keyboard 4000; mapping Browser Search to Ctrl+F also opens the Windows Project panel.
The author later said the Browser Search key appeared in the mapping UI and Ctrl+F worked, but reported that mapping another key to T produced both T and the original My Computer action.

A maintainer tested Browser Home mappings on another keyboard and observed both the browser action and mapped shortcut, supporting a possible simultaneous hardware/vendor action rather than a confirmed Keyboard Manager-only failure.
The July 27, 2026 maintainer comment asks whether the issue persists on 0.100.2 or newer and requests numbered steps; there is no later author response.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the requested current-build retest and exact hardware key behavior; then determine whether the original action is emitted by the keyboard/vendor software independently of the remap.
requested_evidence: Whether the original action still fires on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer
Numbered steps and exact Browser Search mapping
Whether Microsoft Keyboard Center or other vendor software is active

fix_assessment.rationale: The author reported the primary remap working after a software update, and the remaining dual-action symptom has not been revalidated on a current build. Do not propose a code change until the unanswered retest distinguishes a PowerToys failure from an independent keyboard/vendor action.

issue_context.summary: On an MS Natural Ergonomic Keyboard 4000, the Browser Search key was reported to emit both the mapped shortcut and its original Project-panel action; the author later said the Browser Search mapping worked after an update.
known_information: The issue reports PowerToys 0.78.0 on Windows 11 Dev Channel.
The Browser Search key mapped to Ctrl+F reportedly also opened the Project panel.
The author later said the key was available in the mapping UI and Ctrl+F worked, but observed another key remap emit both the target and the original My Computer action.
A maintainer reproduced simultaneous browser and mapped-shortcut behavior with Browser Home on another keyboard.
A July 27, 2026 request for a current-build retest and numbered steps remains unanswered.
inferences: The physical key or vendor software may emit a second action independently of the PowerToys remap, but the issue does not establish whether this occurs on the current build.
The change that made Browser Search appear in the mapping UI may have resolved the original limitation without resolving the separate dual-action behavior.
issue_context.analysis: The thread contains both a report that the key mapping now works and a remaining dual-action observation. Because the current version and exact hardware behavior are unknown, the existing maintainer request is the right gate; avoid treating the older observed behavior as a confirmed present-day PowerToys defect.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and all 15 comments, including the author's later report that the mapping appeared and worked.
Noted the maintainer's Browser Home control test, which observed both the browser action and mapped shortcut on another keyboard.
Confirmed the July 27, 2026 current-build request has no later author response; no linked PR or assignee is present.

information_gaps.information: Whether the dual-action behavior still occurs on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer, with numbered steps naming the physical key and exact mapping.
information_gaps.why_needed: The author reported a partial workaround and the second action may originate from the keyboard or vendor software rather than the remap engine.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest the Browser Search and one alternate key mapping on 0.100.2 or newer, list the key and both observed outputs, and note whether vendor keyboard software is running.
